newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Dow Chemical to take up right to Brazil EDN shares.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical to take up right to Brazil EDN shares.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co's Dow Quimica unit will exercise its right to acquire the entire minority stake in Brazil's petrochemical firm Estireno do Norte (EDN) which was auctioned Thursday, a company official said.

Dow Quimica, which is already a shareholder of EDN, has a preferential right to the 26.74 percent minority stake in EDN which was auctioned on the Rio de Janeiro stock exchange if it claims its right within the next five days.

Finance Director Jose Eduardo Senise said Dow Quimica would make use of its preferential right, which means that pension fund Previmil, which bought part of the minority stake, would have to abandon it.
Dow Quimica acquired 4,283 lots of 1,000 shares in the auction for the minimum price of 36 reais per lot, while Previmil bought the remaining 127 lots for 36.10 reais per lot.
The 26.74 percent stake which was auctioned belonged to Petroquisa, a subsidiary of state oil company Petrobras .
-- Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151
